$comment: T-2.48: the voice pipeline's data (ADR-017). `script` is what docs/audio/voice-script.md asks people to record: each section is one file per pass (`<section>-normal`, `<section>-shout`, and `<section>-hurt` where a section has `hurt` lines), every line said `takesPerLine` times with a second of silence between. `render` is which passes become game lines. `split` finds takes: frames louder than `thresholdDb` below the file's loudest frame, runs closer than `minSilenceMs` joined, runs shorter than `minTakeMs` dropped, each padded. `loudness` is the integrated loudness (ITU-R BS.1770) every line is normalised to, with a peak ceiling. `profiles` are the six slots' voices in slot order: pitch and formant shifts in semitones (moved separately, so deeper does not sound slowed), an EQ, and the drive a shout is saturated with; `speaker` picks a recorded speaker by index (sorted folder names), default the slot modulo the speakers there are. `radio` and `distant` are the two treatments beside `dry`; `treatments` is which are rendered. Each line gets `variants` versions, from its takes in turn and a seeded pitch nudge of up to `variantSemitones`.
